correctness.rationale: For all integer n>=2k>=6, the potential of a unit source–sink pair on adjacent Johnson vertices reduces by label symmetry to positive orbit potentials v_j. The exact Laplace recurrence has n+a_j+b_j on the diagonal, with a_j=j(n-2k+j), b_j=(k-1-j)^2; the maximum principle proves strict positivity and an induction proves strict increase. Detailed balance of N_j yields V=1/n and T=(k-1)(n-k-1)/[2(n-1)], hence the full gradient column sum 2(n-1)V+2T. Edge transitivity and symmetry prove endpoint operator-norm equality. Trace rank N-1 supplies the exact diagonal and thus the complementary cycle norm. Exact Fraction verification passed 308 orbit cases and five independent full graph Laplacians covering 2036 edges. The proof, not the finite enumeration, establishes the infinite claim.

value.rationale: An unrestricted two-parameter, natural distance-regular graph family gains exact sharp canonical edge Hodge operator norms. The formula identifies a genuine rank-density regime change: fixed-rank endpoint norms remain bounded, while on k/n->alpha both norms grow at the sharp rate alpha(1-alpha)n, in particular n/4 on balanced hypersimplex slices despite quadratic degree. This is not a single small numerical evaluation, formal substitution of the known rank-two case, or mere reproducibility.
